WWO Re-Wind: Best of 99

11 January 2000
Content noticeA period document, served as recovered; withheld details are marked. It carries the humor, language, and content typical of its era and community — some of it crude, dated, or offensive, including material that wouldn't be written today. See Curation.
FOlks, what you are about to read is not our usual programming fare for the World Wrestling Organization. It is a collection of the most notable matches, speeches, and actions in the World Wrestling Organization over th past year. I hope you all enjoy .. [name withheld] WWO President -- ******************************** Tommy Boy: I've got a plan! Richard: YIKES!!! ******************************** [Part 1 of 5] [ "Stage" by Live begins to play, as various images of various WWO superstars performing all sorts of moves and the like are shown in rapid succession. Then streaking red letters zoom onto the screen forming the following title: ] /||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||\ || _____ || || | __ \ || || | |__) |___ ______ || || | _ // _ \______| || || | |_\ \ __/ ___ _ _ _____ || || |_|\ \_\___| / (_) \ | | __ \ || || \ \ /\ / / _| \| | | | | || || \ \/ \/ / | | . ` | | | | || || \ /\ / | | |\ | |__| | || || \/ \/ |_|_| \_|_____/ || || || \||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||||/ [ As the images continue slowly as a voice is heard coming over the music] VOICE: Welcome to WWO Re-Wind, the ultimate re-cap show in the world of wrestling. [ Shot of a calendar being flipped from 1999 to 2000.] VOICE: Tonight, on Re-Wind: It's a new year... [ Shots of the lighting of the Eiffel Tower, the Parthenon, and the dropping of the ball at Times Square.] VOICE: And according to some a new millenium... [ Still shots of Wuzho, Fury, Night's Harbinger, Rusty Bowman. ] VOICE: Famous faces go... [ Still shots of Jack Lantern, Mikkael Korn, James Girard, Tigress.] VOICE: New enemies come... [ Still shots of Tyrone Hayes, Roundhouse, Ultimate Thrasher, Fire and Ice.] VOICE: And some stick it out here... [ The image begins to swirl in a dynamic, colourful effect ] VOICE: The World Wrestling Organization! All this tonight ON RE-WIND! [ The picture then fades into a large WWO studio with television sets, people walking around and the like. Sitting at a large oval desk is the voice of the WWO, Mickey Ralph. Ralph is wearing a white shirt with a black WWO jacket; he is a little on the chubby side and has black hair. The camera zooms in on him as he shuffles and rearranges a few sheets of paper which are found on his desk ] VOICE: And here is your host, from the WWO News Control, Mickey Ralph! [ Mickey Ralph raises his head and smiles at the camera as the music fades away ] RALPH: Good evening everybody and welcome to this edition of WWO Re-Wind for 11 January 2000; thank you for being with us. It's a different Rewind this evening that you will all see. No comments from the wrestlers leading up to Season's Beatings on this episode. But don't worry, we'll have those for you in a special Season's Beatings Preview later tonight. RALPH: No, tonight, we take a look back at the year nineteen hundred and ninety nine. According to many the last year of the 1st millenium, and the end of the twentieth century. And folks, it's been a great year for in-ring and out of ring action in the World Wrestling Organization. RALPH: I'm proud to say that every year, I look forward to great things, and last year was no exception. From the top of the card to the rookies who were looking to make a name for themselves. IF they were able to be part of the only federation that is "Simply the Best", they were still a part of history. RALPH: And tonight, we take a long look at those people who were history, those who were part of history, and those who made history. And those who's names will be part of the history of the World Wrestling Organization. So sit back and enjoy, as we take a time warp back to January 1st, 1999 and the showman of all showmen starts us off. Here is Warren Hayes. RALPH: We'll see you at the end of the show. ============================================ New Years Bash Even out of commission...a show stopper... 1/1/99 ============================================ Bradley: You mean we didn't change that label yet? I know Stone wants some things to remain status quo, but come on. Ralph: it's still that. And . [Suddenly, the music of "So Wha'cha Want" by the Beastie Boys begins to play over the intercom system, and it immediately draws a chorus of boos from the crowd.] Bradley: Now this is how you start a show off right. Ralph: Warren Hayes coming down to the ring, and what the hell, he's got his arm in a sling? Bradley: Damn it. The rumble is totally ruined now. I mean no Ratings, no show. Ralph: Warren coming out in this champagne coloured suit. And Warren sharing a few words with the fans. He's taunting them, and then showing off his injury. What is this? Bradley: It's called making sure the mob doesn't take advantage of you when you're hurt. And you know who is to blame for this. Ralph: Whoever it was that forged a medical record? Bradley: Roundhouse. If Roundhouse had left well enough alone at Season's Beatings, none of this would be necessary. Ralph: Even after Warren put that hockey helmet to use on Bowman. And now we're supposed to believe that Warren's hurt now? Bradley: Can he help it if it flared up after the evening was over? Ralph: Warren asking for the microphone and now climbing into the ring. HAYES: HELLLLOOOOOOOOO FANBOYS! < crowd boos heavily HAYES: I know, I know... you're all disappointed because this sling and this suit are the harbingers of very bad tidings. They are all supposing that Warren Hayes is not fit to wrestle tonight. And knowing that you all paid to see "Mr. Ratings" Warren Hayes enter the battle royal and go through it to become the #1 contender to the WWO World Heavyweight Championship, I am sure the following news will disappoint you all a great deal. < he smacks his lips, looking somewhat disappointed HAYES: I will NOT be part of the New Year's Bash battle royal. < the crowd cheers loudly at the thought of not having to endure Warren Hayes for the rest of the evening HAYES: I know, I know, it's terrible. I'm sure the arena will gladly refund you in full, though. But now, let me get to the point. Just so that you don't get all your hopes up too high, no, I'm not here to explain the situation with STB. Like I said in the past, STB is NOT splitting up, but I can't say more right now. Besides, the reason for my coming out here tonight is to explain why I cannot wrestle tonight. HAYES: As you all can see, ladies and gentlemen, my arm is currently in a sling. That being in a sling obviously means that it is injured. Now don't worry, don't get into an uproar, I'm fine, really, and I will wrestle again. While the injury is not too severe, it has been diagnosed as an acute sprain which, while not dangerously career ending, will need time to heal and will prevent me from performing. HAYES: And how long will that be, may you ask? Well, the doctors say that it can be somewhere between three to six months before it heals completely and I can return to the ring. < he shakes his head in "disappointment" HAYES: I have medical papers now which ban me from stepping into a wrestling ring to compete and... < sobs there's nothing I can do about it. Those are doctor's orders and I must, as a professional, respect them, even though wrestling is my livelihood and my way of life. It's as the old saying goes: you can take a man out of the jungle, but you can't take the jungle out of a man. < he sobs; the crowd has started a "WARREN SUCKS" chant, which spreads quite rapidly throughout the arena HAYES: And all of this, all of this pain which I feel right now both physical and psychological, is all because of ONE MAN! One man alone is responsible for sidelining me and making me suffer this terrible, terrible ordeal. And that man is ROUNDHOUSE. < the crowd cheers upon hearing the name of the beer-guzzling fan favourite HAYES: You see, if my arm is injured so tonight, it is because of that heinous and completely unprovoked attack which Roundhouse inflicted upon me a few weeks ago at Seasons Beatings. In the process of trying to defend myself from his cruel attack, my arm was extended in a way which nature did not intend it to, and now I am stuck with THIS. < points to the sling HAYES: Roundhouse, this is all your fault. Now, I am sidelined for at least three months. I have a medical official who states that I cannot wrestle until I am healed, lest risking the chance of aggravating my injury. In your mindless haste to get your hands on me, YOU have cancelled our match at the first Showcase of the year. Because it is plainly stated in our contract, just like in any other wrestling contract, that both wrestlers must have complete medical clearance to wrestle, which is a luxury I do not have right now, because of YOU. < the crowd boos heavily and Warren cannot help but crack a sly grin HAYES: If you had been even the least bit intelligent, if you had done the smart thing and prevented your stupid, petty emotions from getting the best of you, you would have waited until our match to fight me. You got me unprepared, unready, I wasn't warmed up, I didn't do my stretches... you did what you had to do, you secured the match by beating Chris Johnson, but by attacking me like a crazed loonie, YOU RUINED IT ALL. There was nothing more that I would have liked than to kick your sorry colonised rump for a third time, but YOU RUINED IT ALL. There was nothing more that the fans wanted to see than Roundhouse and Warren Hayes fight each other but YOU RUINED IT ALL. < he pauses for a second and smiles at the camera HAYES: It was the match you wanted, it was the primary reason you returned to the WWO, and you screwed it up. It's all your fault, Roundhouse. You ruined it all. So on behalf of the WWO and especially on behalf of that fat tub of goo Roundhouse, I would like to apologise to all you fans here tonight and to all those who will have bought tickets to see Warren Hayes wrestle and will not have the chance to do so. If you have anyone to blame, blame Roundhouse. Thank you for your time, fanboys. [Warren then tosses the microphone down on the canvas, and makes his way out of the ring, very slowly pushing the ropes down and climbing his way through them, even stopping on the floor to grab at his arm, as though in pain.] Bradley: See. What did I tell you? Roadhouse, you screwed up. You had your chance, but now there's nothing. And you took Hayes out of his rightful position to get into the ring and claim that number one position for the world gold And you screwed up the rumble for the rest of us. You took the number one man out of the contest! Smooth move, billboard! ============================================ 1/14/99 The Formation of the Hall of Fame ============================================ [The camera comes back and focuses on the ring, when all of a sudden the crowd starts to roar as "Among the Living" by Anthrax starts to play, and Ultimate Thrasher, guitar slung over his shoulder, makes his way down the aisle up into the ring accompanied by Sweet Melissa, the couple slapping the hands of almost every fan along the aisle. Thrasher bounds into the ring and grabs the house mic, holding the ropes open for Melissa.] Bradley: Hey!! Hey!! Ike doesn't need to be out here now with Tina! The Turner's have a match for later! This is my time of the show! Ralph: Your time? Bradley: That's ri... Thrasher: Hellooooo Manchester! How ya doin tonight? *crowd roars* Bradley: He's jealous!! That's what it is!! He couldn't handle me being the spotlight, so he had... Thrasher: Are you ready to rock? Well...before I get down to business and mop the mat with the blood of the Pacific Northwest's favorite loser, I've got a little announcement to make! *crowd hushes up* Bradley: He's leaving for the second ti... Thrasher: Now, over the past couple of weeks, you've heard a few things about the newest members of the WWO Hall of Fame being inducted. Well, with a couple of exceptions, have you ever noticed how everyone who's been inducted to the official WWO Hall of Fame just plain sucks? I have, and so have a few friends of mine, so we've decided to change things! Bradley Am I ever going to fin... Thrasher: First, one thing we didn't like, is that everyone in the official Hall of Fame is long gone! History! Yesterday's news! We had a hard time voting, because we hardly remember any of them! Another thing is, these guys really didn't have to beat anyone to win the championships that they did win! The Little Sisters of the Poor could have won them! So, me and my friends have decided that the WWO Hall of Fame was in need of an enema! Ladies and gentlemen, me and my friends have come here to introduce the REAL Hall of Fame! Our first member is a former WIF International and Tag Team Champion. In the BWFE he was a Streetfight and Television Champion, and in the NLWA he won the Great Lakes title. But titles don't tell the entire story, as he's had some of the most intense wars ever with men like Fury, Sapphire, Wazza, and Dr. Doom. I give you the "Big Unit", ROUNDHOUSE!! *"Mine" by the Hoodoo Gurus plays and the crowd erupts once again as Roundhouse walks out, beer and smoke in hand, letting rip on the air guitar before making his way down to the ring and high-fiving Thrasher as he walks in* Roundhouse: HEY GEEEEENNNNNN MEEEEEAAN!!!!!!!!!!! HEY MANCHESTER!!!!!! I've got one question. Has anyone seen Wazza tonight??? Hell Manchester I'm ready to wrestle tonight but it seems I don't have an opponent, well at least I don't seem to have an opponent with any testicles. But on the night that Hall of Fame debut I promise you that I will indeed be competing. If Wazza doesn't show then I'll head out the back and find myself another wrestler, I don't care who, but I promise you this, you're hard earned Euros will be well spent tonight. Now onto matters Hall of Fame. For the last year the major stable has been the STB, but the term `has been' applies oh so well. The stable of 1999 will be the Hall of Fame, every member a multiple champion, no losers, no second rate mid carders to boost our numbers. Thrasher: Thank you Roundhouse! It's nice to have the Hall of Fame inductees actually being around to accept their inductions for a change! Now, next up Manchester, get ready to get it up... Melissa *to Thrasher*: GIVE it up... Thrasher: That's what I said! Melissa: No, you....ah, forget it. Thrasher: Anyway, get ready to meet our next inductees to the REAL Hall of Fame! The unquestioned greatest tag team in wrestling history! They've won the tag team titles in almost every federation they've ever been in, including the APCW, PGF, HCW, four times in the WIF, and five times in the BWFE! Nothing short of intercontinental ballistic missiles is going to stop them from doing so here in the WWO. Ladies and gentlemen...the thunder from down under, the team of SEARCH AND DESTROY! *"Mine" by the Hoodoo Gurus plays once again as the tag team duo makes its way into the ring. Search wearing the red jersey of Manchester United and Destroy the blue of Manchester City. This draws an even bigger pop from the crowd as they make their way towards the ring. Before climbing into the ring the tag team sensation bow to Thrasher and Roundhouse in the ring who continue hamming it up and return the gesture much to the delight of the fans who have now broken out in soccer chants* Search: So do you think the Devils will make it through Europe this year? *huge crowd response* Destroy: What about City just getting their arses out of second division and returning to some glory days? *another huge response from the soccer mad English fans*. Well we couldn't think of a better place to introduce the Hall of Fame, Maine Road, a name synonymous with championship performances. Manchester, a city renowned the world over for being home to champions. *another huge response* Search: Well there isn't much more to say that hasn't been said, but make sure to keep an eye on the Hall of Fame because they will be at the centre of all major happenings in the WWO from now on. We've wrestled in most every continent on this planet and won more gold than the Queen keeps at London Tower, but tonight is something new. Tonight we're joining a team of true champions, a stable that will become the biggest thing ever seen in the wrestling world. A stable that will put the WWO onto the world map in a way Stone could not ever have imagined. With the Big Unit, Thrash and Andy we'll take the WWO by the balls!!! Search: And shake it till its eyes bleed! Thrasher: There you have it folks, the first and only tag team in the REAL Hall of Fame! Now, for our fourth member, I'm going to bring you the man who has been a power player in the WWO for a longer time than ANYONE. I'm going to bring you the man who has dominated to the point of not one but TWO WWO World Heavyweight Championships and one US Title, Two WIF Internet and International Titles, one WAR! National Championship, and a GRW Global Title, Ladies and gentlemen..ANDROS!! *"Miami" by Will Smith plays as Andros, grinning, makes his way into the ring with a roar from the crowd and takes the microphone from Thrasher* Andros: Thank you Thrasher. [ looks around the ring ] It's great to be surrounded by my friends right in this very ring. This is an honor, a GREAT honor to be inducted to this Hall of Fame, the REAL Hall of Fame. Weeks ago Lenny Wacus stated that I was shoe in for the WWO's Hall of Fame, and gosh darnit he was right. The only problem is, I'm not in the WWO's Hall of Fame - I'm in OUR Hall of Fame. Just like Thrasher said, not only are we the elite members of the WWO, but we are also alive and kicking. Unlike other certain members of the WWO's Hall Of Fame. In the months to come, the HOF will show its dominance over the WWO, especially of Simply the Best. When _I_ created STB, I wanted it to be the best group around, with a variety of talent. As soon as Warren Hayes took over, it became a temple for the worship of Mr.Hayes himself. I, of course ... am not the creator of this group surronding me - no, WE are the creators, but with the creation of this group you will notice every member is a legend in his own right. Whether we've won titles, awards or anything else ... we all have one thing in common ... WE'RE IN THE HALL OF FAME!!! [ grin ] Thrasher: Now, one other difference between... Melissa: *interrupting* Aren't you forgetting one member? Thrasher: No, I introduced everyone I was supposed to... Melissa: Oh, for crying out loud! *imitating Thrasher* Ladies and gentlemen, I give to you a man who thinks he has redefined the sport of wrestling in the final half of the last decade of the 20th Century. His technical wrestling prowess leaves something to be desired, but his will to win most definitely does not. I give you the former WWO IP Champion, former WWO IP Tag TeamChampion, former WIF World Tag Team Champion, and certified bonehead, the ULLLTIMATE THRASHER! Thrasher: *with a look of mock shock* Why, thank you! I had no idea this was coming at all! *laughs* One last thing I'd like to point out is, the main difference between THAT Hall of Fame and THIS Hall of Fame is this: All those guys are retired, resting on their laurels, never to be heard from again...but us guys up here are far from through! We haven't even peaked yet! We've got years of asses to kick and beers to drink ahead of us! So keep that in mind, STB, and whoever else decides to cross our path! The best damn fighting force in the history of the WWO has been assembled! Ladies and gentlemen....THE HALL OF FAME!! Bradley: Yeah, right. You just wait boys. After Warren is well enough to demolish you chumps... [Suddenly "Among the Living" begins to play once again, and the group of wrestlers in the ring all climb out to the floor, drawing further pops from the crowd, before making their way over to the ring railing, and they literally climb themselves over the ring railing and assume a row of empty seats there in front of the crowd, as the camera shot changes back to the ring once again.] ============================================ 1/14/99 WWO Television Championship Match "Money Driven" Mike Sebastian vs. Night Stalker [c] ============================================ Calhoun: Ladies and gentlemen, the following contest is scheduled for one fall, with a fifteen minute time limit, and it is for the World Wrestling Organization's Television Championship. Calhoun: Introducing first the challenger... [Suddenly over the P.A. system, is heard the auctioneer John Michael Montgomery's "Sold", followed by a loud "ringing" of a cash register, and the crowd immediately begins to go into a chorus of boos.] Calhoun: He hails from Palm Springs, California, and weighs in at 259 pounds, ladies and gentlemen, this is "MONEY DRIVEN" MIKE SEBASTIAN!!! Bradley: Why? I'm more interested in seeing Warren beat Roundhouse with one hand wrapped up in a sling. Ralph: Warren's already said he won't be here to wrestle, but we do know he's in the building. And the rumour was that Sebastian had retired, but here comes, and to forgo a retirement for one title shot, has to say something about the WWO gold belt. Bradley: Don't forget Warren's big surprise! Ralph: We're waiting on "Pins and needles". Bradley: See. That alone is worth the price of admission. I mean this is Warren's chance to get even for all the stunts that Bill Board has brought with him. Ralph: Well one of them is going to stand, as President Stone made it clear that at the moment Andros is in the World Wrestling Organization. Bradley: But Warren will have the last laugh. And he'll have the TV Title back in his group of friends. Ralph: And is Chris Johnson in that group? Bradley: Of course. Ralph: Then who ordered the attack in Johnson's dressing room? Bradley; Of course he's not. Ralph: Thank you for clearing that up. [The music then changes as Sebastian undoes the clasps and pulls off the suit, and "The Memory Remains" by Metalica begins to play over the intercom system, and the boos do not abate in the slightest, as the video wall lights up to show the TV champion in various scenes.] Ralph: We got some recorded comments earlier from both combatants in this contest, so let's hear first from the challenger. [Scene cuts to a shot of Mike Sebastian sitting in a recliner chair in what looks to be a plush room. Sebastian is dressed in one of his many Armani suits, as to where he has a microphone clipped onto his collar. As the camera pans around the room eyeing various art paintings and antiques, it is quite apparent that the fans tuning in now find themselves on the interior of Mike Sebastian's elustrious estate. Sebastian soon flashes his trademark arrogant grin back in return, and speaks.] MS: Yeah, yeah... I know what yer thinkin'... [His tone changes now, to more of a high-pitched sound.] "Money Driven" ain't gotta hopin' hell o' walkin' out Thursday night as the Television champion... he isn't prepared... he isn't ready... he hasn't got what it takes to wear WWO gold... I've heard 'em all. But the fact is, I know what I'm bringin' to the table at the Showcase. I know what I can do inside that ring. Night Stalker doesn't. But the question is, Stalker... [A smirk.] Do you wanna find out? [Sebastian glares back at the camera now, with an abrupt scowl upon his face. He just cannot seem to relax, it seems.] MS: Because, let's think about this for a second... How long have you had that belt wrapped around your waist, Stalker? March, you said? So, I guess that puts us at about the nine month mark. You've had that belt fer a long time, Stalks. It's just that you've had it about nine months too long... And my job is to end this little title reign o' yours before your head gets any _bigger_ than it already is. [A nod.] And when it's all said an' done, Stalks... ... it's gonna be a job well done. [Mike pauses, and rubs his chin. The sound of his hand rubbing against the light stubble can be heard. The camera zooms in now, revealing the scruff upon Mike's face. Obviously, the man has not shaved in a few days.] MS: I went through hell just to be in the number one contender to that strap o' yours, Stalker. And, I'll walk through hell, fire, and brimstone if it means me walkin' out as the tee-vee champ. Because lemme tell ya a l'il somethin', hoss, I didn't come this far fer nothin'. I rolled through Roundhouse, Spawn, Hudson, and St. Claire for one thing -- to meet you. And now that this match is here, Stalker, I ain't plannin' on walkin' home empty-handed. Because, if ya haven't taken notice just yet, "Money Driven" is back in town. An' he's lookin' to collect. [He sighs with a deep exhale now.] Y'know, everybody says I've come in to the WWO and done more in such a short amount o' time than anyone before me... [He shrugs.] It doesn't mean a thing 'till I got somethin' to prove 'em right. [Sebastian takes a quick look down towards his, now vacant waist.] MS: But, it ain't like I need some fifteen pounds worth o' tin to prove how much of a threat I am to the WWO's talent. I do that just fine _without_ a belt. Because after Thursday evenin', whether I'm Television champion or not, if you think you got what it takes to beat Mike Sebastian, then you come try "Money Bags" on fer size. We'll play. I hate fighting... But I _love_ to play... [A quick grin.] An' that's all Night Stalker an' I have been doin' fer the past couple o' months. We been playin' mind games with one another. But come Thursday night, the mind games ain't gonna mean too much. Cause Stalker, if yer lucky, you _might_ walk outta that ring with at least _one_ o' the things you walked in with... ... yer life. But as fer yer belt and about six pints o' blood... [Sebastian chuckles.] I wouldn't count on it. [He kicks the footrest down, and rises to his feet. He places his hands on his hips and stares back in content.] MS: Cause whether you choose to believe it or not, Night Stalker, there ain't a single person gracin' the WWO roster than can give ya a run fer yer money like Mike Sebastian... An' when it's all said and done out there, Stalker, and when you see that belt wrapped 'round "Money Driven's" waist, I just hope you finally realize that ya finally met yer match. Sure, it may have taken nine months, but somebody finally came along who could beat ya, and did... ... an' his name is "Money Driven" Mike Sebastian. WWO Television Champion. An' after you've received yer medical treatment fer the night, Stalker, I want ya to sit back... relax... and take _that_... [He winks back in return.] ... to the bank. [And we are left seeing the perhaps, next Television Champion staring back in determination, as the scene returns to the ring, where Stalker is seen still staring at a few of the fans, and even arguing with one who carries a sign that reads "Stalker fears Spawn".] Bradley: Now that's what you call the life of luxury. Why doesn't my dressing room look like that? Ralph: Maybe if you went out and spent that extra bribe money that Hayes and Sebastian have been giving you. Bradley: That was hard earned cash! Ralph: For what? Bradley: Stuff. Ralph: Stuff? That's all? Bradley: Yeah, stuff. Ralph: Bringing the morning paper and coffee must be really taxing for them to have you do it. Bradley: Hey!! What I do for my extra cash is my own business. Ralph: Anyone have the number for the Internal Revenue Service? But now let's hear from the Television Champion. <The scene opens up with the Night Stalker walking down the row of seats searching for his seat. He is carrying his black carry-on bag and a black leather coat that he's slung over his shoulder. Stalker finally finds his seat, stores his carry-on safely in the overhead and takes his seat, luckily it seems that no one is sitting beside the WWO TV champ. The camera man walks up to the champ and zooms in on his handsome yet rugged face. Stalker is wearing his normal wrap around shades along with a tight black t-shirt, a thick gold chain wraps around his 20 inch neck.] Night Stalker Well, well, well... at long last the great WWO camera crew has finally fit time into their busy schedule to come visit the true legend of the WWO, Well i'm glad because after about 2 weeks or so of being off TV, i have some things to say. First off lets cover the doings that transpired at the New Years Bash.... starting off with the Genius. Boy I had you beat 3 different times during the match, I just didn't want to put you out of your misery quite yet that's all. I had you begging for mercy! I thrashed you within an inch of your god forsaken life.... you were just pathetic... crying and carying on right in the middle of the match. For days the haunting sound you your screams almost kept me awake, the constant crying of "Oh god Stalker, no more! Beat me already Stalker! You're the champ, the master, the legend! I can't handle it!! Oh dear lord!!" Man that was really sad, I always thought a Harcore guy like you might be able to take an ass kickin' without all the cryin' and bellowin'. Well I guess I was wrong, it happens every once and a while. The only thing I think that was more pathetic then your antics and crying in the ring, was that of which you did the following WWO show... man if that wasn't a desperate man clinging to his brush with a legacy, i don't know what is! Please, do you think that I would first off even grant you a re-match for the title nonetheless agree to all those silly stipulations? Jesus H. Christ Genius, I have no idea how you got that name, but I'm damn sure its not for being smart. You wanted to take away any advantage I could possibly have right? Well why the hell would i agree to that? Huh? Punk! The two strut towards the ring. Johnstone threatens a few fans at ringside while Tyrone hops up on the ring apron, strutting along sides until he goes into the ring and leans against the corner. Sliding a microphone from out of his jacket pocket, Todd Johnstone quickly hands the instruament of disfunction to the ever jovial Hayes. Tyrone flashes the camera one of his infamous smirks for good measure.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: Hit it boys. [Suddenly an extremely large explosition is heard... and from the rafters a large banner proclaiming we "Celebrate Our Cultural Dyversyty" unfurls. The lights being to go back to normal, and Tyrone and Todd nod in agreement. Just as it seems as everything has gone to normal, several more loud POPs can be heard from different points in the arena. The flag of Canada, Quebec, the United Kingdom, the state of California, the infamous Hanna Barbara cartoon dog with one large tooth sometimes called Fang, and one with a sad yellow face in black make-up are unfurled. Tyrone stands proundly as a large net from above the ring is opened and a pile of Hello Kitty! happy smilely faced tea party invitations and balloons float down upon the crowd.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: Today my friends, today is a very special day! For quite some time I've been deriding people based on their ethnicity, and the inherent stupidity in which it brings. But last week... last week at that Thanksgiving card that was over stuffed with crap, I learned to sort of like some people. Take for instance: Les Canadians. [Tyrone gives a slight moment for the crowd to cheer a bit for the Canadian duo... before squelching it with a high pitched feed back.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: I know. Les Canadians. Two guys from a nation that's chief exports are ice and hockey players. Canada. A place where people get together to throw rocks at other rocks for entertainment. But wait, they also _SWEEP_ the ice to further enhance this amazing test of conciousness and stupidity. Canada. A waste of maybe 40 acres of usable garbage dumping land. Canada. Only a place where the only thing lower than the temperature is its inhabitants' collective IQ's would dare spawn two people who's only managable witty line for me was calling me... Barney. Sheesh, as if Roundhouse hasn't already run out of ideas on what to call me, you two have the gall to steal one of his few "witty" comebacks. [Our audience begins to boo Tyrone, but he just soaks it up and basks in his own glory.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: But I accept you for what you are. Two backwards morons who are waaaaaaaaaaay out of their league in a place that has duh fancy indoor plumbing we 'eard aboot in Canada, EH? [A small Union Jack chant as begun, which is Tyrone's que to stir up some more trouble.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: I'll get to him too, don't worry. But for now I'll have to deal with "Monkey Shines" Mike Sebastian. Monkey Shines. People ask me why I compare Mike Sebastian to a monkey. The term monkey shines is why. Through no actual display of talent, no actual use of what little skill he has, he manages to steal a title that didn't belong to him. Sebastian and his army of cronies: Fang, Les Canadians, and Christopher Bonetaker have managed to do what I couldn't do. These 5 men managed to do what I couldn't do against 6: take that IP title away from Johnny Detson. Through some fancy mouthwork, and probably a few too many packages of various condiments, Mike Sebastian managed to slip into the backdoor and steal the IP title away. His shinanigans and outright pathetic attempts to win your people's moronic hearts have made me physically ill... but I accept him for what he is. [Tremendous jeers greet Tyrone as he simply waves off the crowd. The audience continues to try and drown Tyrone in their loud rejection of what he's said, but Tyrone seems to be feeding off of it. Another large dose of feed back hits the crowd and Tyrone seizes the chance to continue to speak his peace.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: I accept you Mike Sebastian, for being a snivelling little twerp who just can't seem to make up his mind about what he wants to be when he grows up. I accept you for being a coward, liar, cheat, and down right wart on the darkest section of the anus of human history. I, Tyrone Hayes, understand you're nothing but a bitch who's lip service has gotten him to where he is. I accept you Mike... _I_ ACCEPT YOU! Crowd: SEBAS-TIAN, SEABAS-TIAN, SEABAS-TIAN!!! Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: Don't waste your precious time calling on that twit. Why don't you call your other hero, "the Quebeccer sans a Pecker" Warren Hayes? I'm sure old Wazza wouldn't mind coming down here and messing up another show with his self indulgent crap. He's a pretty boy posuer who comes all the way down from Canajuh. He goes oot there in the wild Canajun wilderness and forges for hair gel amongst the wild felching fiends of Manitoba. He's made something of himself despite being born not only French, but Canadian! Warren works those 3 and 3/4ths extra chromosomes he has, the coward and pants messing ones that make up the French, for all they are worth. Warren has managed to beat Fury TWICE! Wow, and with only help from the entire nation of Canajuh. I bet he sure feels special, just like all his teachers told him he was. But you know what Warren? Depsite all your flaws, despite your lack of a spine, inspite of your glaring lack of even the tiniest shread of courage... Crowd: WAR-REN, WAR-REN, WAR-REN!!! Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: That's who I'm talking about... fanboys. Inspite of all your flaws Warren, I, the only man who truly has earned the name Hayes, accept you. Just like I accept those poor misguided fools like Vyolynce for what they are. Crowd: WAR-REN, SEBAS-TIAN!!! WAR-REN, SEBAS-TIAN!!! [Smirking and shaking his head, Tyrone is obviously amused at the crowd's cries for their heroes. It falls on deaf ears though, as the only one there is Tyrone. Hayes lifts the microphone again, and inhales deeply.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: Yes, goths. All kids loathe goths. Not me, though. I personally find them amusing. Don't they just have the cutest little names. Like Vyolynce, or Pystylynce, or Nyght Shade, Belyal, "Dank Anus" Bryan O' How Y Enjoy NeYl-yng yn Front of My Father or even Dread of Nyght. I just love all these types. They are just so spooky and haunted. I don't know whether to run up and hug them, or to just beat the living sh[TV EDIT] out of them. You've chosen to come into the WWO Vyolynce, but I've chosen to kick you out. Consider me a sort of welcoming committee... and zoning authority. Whiny, dark, and tormented bitches go over in the corner with Zac Schnieder and Mason. Get yourself a real name and a maybe a few days out in the sun. It'll do you some good. Of course, rather than let you think I don't like you for who you are inside, I want you to know I say things things because I care about you. I can accept your idiotic lifestyle... nay, I _DO_ accept your idiot lifestyle, and I accept the idea of you being shown the door by me. But most of all, I accept _YOU_. [The crowd is frenzied at this point. Chants of Warren Hayes, Mike Sebastian, Union Jack, Les Canadians, heck anyone who can shut up Tyrone, are heard. Even a few Vyolynce chants are heard.] Tyrone "Purple" Hayes: Last, and least: Union Jack. I beat on your silly little bollocks a few months back. I beat your ass so badly that your body matched the colors of your flag. Now that you've lost your mask, I wish I had remembered to pound your face a little less. You are one ugly son of a skank if I ever saw one. But that's okay. You are who you are: a talentless hack who just won't go away despite my rendering you about as dangerous as a voice activated bomb in the presence of Patrick Shade. You talk about your family, and how they were shamed into disowning you. Sorry to say that's bullocks. They seized the oppotunity to drop you like the doctor did on the day you were born. Jacky, babe, you're just another in the long list of Commonwealth scum I've dispensed with. You all smell bad, have horrible dental hygiene, and can't wrestle for sh[TV EDIT], but you know what? I accept you. So let's just finish this match, and maybe I'll send you a nice little pair of kecks when you're finished wetting the ones you've got on. ============================================ [The camera reopens on Mickey Ralph who has stepped out from behind the desk, and is revealed to be wearing long blue docker slacks in addition to his WWO office shirt.] MR: Folks, it's been a great year, and if 1999 is any indication, we're going to be rolling into the new millenium hotter than ever.
